author: JD Humburg
title: Jesuit hires head football coach to succeed legendary Ken Potter - NewsBreak
text:
By JD Humburg ,
4 hours ago Jesuit announced Wednesday that Phil Rombach will be the school’s next head football coach. Rombach, a 2002 graduate of Jesuit, served as the head coach at St. Michael’s Catholic Preparatory School in Austin, Texas, from 2023-25. He spent 16 seasons coaching in a variety of roles at Linfield University, where as a player he helped the program win four conference titles and a national championship as a team captain and an all-conference linebacker.
